welcome.title: Welcome to Hart County
body: Welcome to the official Hart County website. Here you can find county news, alerts, meeting information, and resources for residents, businesses, and visitors.
We are committed to providing clear, timely information and making county services easier to access online.
Please take some time to look around the site and let us know if there are other areas of interest or services you would like us to offer online.
Hart County is an Equal Opportunity Employer - E-Verify ID#47141, authorized July 1, 2007.
